meta.name: Leanne
meta.description:
When her husband leaves her for another woman, a resilient Southern mom starts over with the support of her loving, but unfiltered family.

Rated TV-14 · Returning Series · First aired 31 Jul 2025 · United States of America · Language: English
Studio: Chuck Lorre Productions, Warner Bros. Television · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 16/16 | S2 10/10

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: The Important Stuff
videos.overview: Facing the abrupt end of her marriage, Leanne leans on her sister Carol, concocts cover stories and confronts the prospect of starting over in her 50s.

videos.title: The Healing Magic of Family
videos.overview: When Mama Margaret suffers a health scare, Leanne scrambles to keep the family from upsetting her by spilling the beans about Bill.

videos.title: Oh, Knoxville
videos.overview: It's ladies' night as Carol whisks Leanne out of her comfort zone and into a local hotspot for a crash course in confidence.

videos.title: Smooth Like a Dolphin
videos.overview: With a lawyer in one ear and Carol in the other, Leanne considers a fresh look and a new ride. An unwanted guest threatens to spoil game day.

videos.title: A Plumber Sent from Heaven
videos.overview: Leanne sets out to get fit, but temptation is hard to shake — especially after discovering that Carol has a midnight snack of her own.

videos.title: Too Much Wedding Ring
videos.overview: A visit from a charismatic law enforcement officer sets off sirens for Leanne. Daddy John finds a gender reveal party to be anything but a piece of cake.

videos.title: Please Be a Lizard
videos.overview: Leanne's routine gyno exam gets shaken up by a surprise encounter in the waiting room. Carol and Bill mellow out after sampling some enhanced goodies.

videos.title: Muscle Memory
videos.overview: Leanne gets hot and bothered — but not in the way she'd hoped. Carol and Tyler join their elders for an unexpectedly lively night at the movies.

videos.title: Chipmunk in the Drywall
videos.overview: A stack of treasured heirlooms resurfaces old sibling tensions. To keep an embarrassing truth under wraps, Mary agrees to mop up Carol's mess.

videos.title: Apology Pie
videos.overview: Concerned that Andrew's poker face might be masking something deeper, a suspicious Leanne ropes Carol into an undercover investigation.

videos.title: Dog Day Afternoon
videos.overview: As Leanne readies for an exciting step forward, Carol looks back — and realizes her love life could use some serious quality control.

videos.title: The Queen's Dilemma
videos.overview: When Leanne's off-the-cuff speech at a local book club is caught on video, her empowering words turn out to be more powerful than anyone expected.

videos.title: Don't Dangle a Dream
videos.overview: Leanne vows to fulfill Mama Margaret's decades-old dream of a perfect wedding day. But when her rushed plans go off the rails, she'll have to improvise.

videos.title: Gomez Is a Woman
videos.overview: When a long-distance farewell hits close to home, Leanne finds herself rattled by a surprise introduction that stirs up insecurities — and jealousy.

videos.title: Spiritual Airbags
videos.overview: After a brush with fate, Leanne decides to tie up loose ends, Carol experiments with her softer side and Sunday service gets an unexpected reboot.

videos.title: Having Big Feelings
videos.overview: Whisked away for a surprise weekend of sun and sand, Leanne faces her first big relationship test. But an even bigger surprise awaits back at home.

videos.title: The Big Hm-Hm
videos.overview: On the eve of her birthday, Leanne must step in to help Mama Margaret and Daddy John after their forgetfulness leads to an alarming mishap at home.

videos.title: A Prison of Love
videos.overview: Leanne struggles to set boundaries as Mama Margaret and Daddy John begrudgingly stay at her house. A spilled secret throws Bill's life into chaos.

videos.title: The Old Cat Had Her Reasons
videos.overview: As her relationship takes a surprising turn, Leanne questions her own desires — and the women at her book club chime in with conflicting advice.

videos.title: Fit as a Fiddle
videos.overview: A trip to the doctor forces Leanne and Daddy John to have an overdue chat about the future — and helps Carol and Mama Margaret bond like never before.

videos.title: Big Hammer Energy
videos.overview: While Bill helps remodel her parents' kitchen, Leanne wrestles with her feelings. A garden project digs up trouble between Carol and Mama Margaret.

videos.title: An Enhancement... Or Two
videos.overview: After an awkward encounter, Leanne and Carol hit the road with Mary to recapture some of their youthful glow. Daddy John deals Bill in on poker night.

videos.title: Pickles are Forever
videos.overview: Daddy John and Leanne butt heads during a visit to the estate lawyer. After exceeding expectations, Bill makes a case to continue remodeling the house.

videos.title: Have a Rocky Top Day
videos.overview: An unexpected guest visits Leanne, raising questions about love and second chances. Mama Margaret arranges a date for Carol with an eligible stranger.

videos.title: Three Degrees of Southern Women
videos.overview: At long last, Leanne starts speaking her mind — much to Mama Margaret's dismay. Bill tries to help Daddy John tune up his driving knowledge.

videos.title: Bang Me
videos.overview: As Leanne reaches the one-year mark of her separation, a heart-to-heart with her stylist helps reframe her perspective on the past and present.
